Duration: 6 HoursPick-Up: 8:45 – 9:30 AMLanguages: English and Spanish

Today’s tour takes you through the historic and cultural core of Mexico City, where ancient Aztec foundations, colonial architecture, and modern city life coexist.

Your exploration begins in the Historic Center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through the iconic Zócalo, one of the largest public squares in the world, surrounded by monumental landmarks including the Metropolitan Cathedral and the archaeological remains of Templo Mayor, once the ceremonial heart of the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlan.

Continue past the magnificent Palacio de Bellas Artes, known for its striking architecture and artistic importance, and stroll through Alameda Central, a vibrant park where art, culture, and daily city life come together.

Later, visit the world-renowned National Museum of Anthropology (closed on Mondays). This extraordinary museum showcases Mexico’s pre-Hispanic civilizations through remarkable artifacts and exhibits. Admire the famous Aztec Sun Stone, the impressive Olmec heads, and countless other historical treasures that reveal the depth of Mexico’s ancient heritage. Throughout the tour, your certified bilingual guide will provide engaging explanations that bring the history and culture vividly to life.

After the tour, you will return to your hotel, or you may choose to stay out and enjoy lunch while continuing to experience the rhythm of the city.

Tour Highlights

• Walk through Mexico City’s Historic Center and stand above the ruins of ancient Tenochtitlan.• Visit the monumental Metropolitan Cathedral and admire the Palacio de Bellas Artes.• Explore the National Museum of Anthropology, home to iconic artifacts such as the Aztec Sun Stone.• Discover Mexico’s history and culture through the insights of a certified bilingual guide.• Enjoy a well-balanced experience combining guided exploration and personal free time.

Round-trip transportation is included for a smooth and comfortable tour.

Included:• Shared transportation• Certified bilingual guide• Entrance to the National Museum of Anthropology• City tour• Overnight stay in Mexico City

Not Included:• Meals• Drinks• Tips• Personal expenses

blocks.text:
Duration: 10 HoursPick-Up: 8:45 – 9:30 AMLanguages: English and Spanish

Today you will travel from Mexico’s most important religious sanctuary to one of the most impressive archaeological sites in the world.

Your day begins with a visit to the Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe, the most important pilgrimage site in Latin America. As you explore the Basilica complex, you’ll experience the deep spiritual atmosphere that attracts millions of visitors each year. Visit the original 16th-century chapel and the striking modern Basilica, where the revered image of the Virgin of Guadalupe is displayed.

The journey then continues to Teotihuacan, the legendary “City of the Gods.” Walk along the famous Avenue of the Dead and marvel at the enormous Pyramids of the Sun and the Moon, two of the most iconic structures of ancient Mesoamerica. With your expert guide’s explanations, the ancient city comes alive as you learn about its sophisticated engineering, cosmic alignments, mythology, and the powerful civilization that once thrived here long before the Aztecs.

After this extraordinary day of discovery, you will return to your hotel in Mexico City to relax and reflect on your journey through Mexico’s spiritual and ancient past.

Tour Highlights

• Visit the Basilica of Guadalupe, one of the most important religious sites in the Americas.• Explore the ancient city of Teotihuacan, a major pre-Hispanic archaeological site.• Admire the monumental Pyramid of the Sun and Pyramid of the Moon.• Learn about Teotihuacan’s mythology, cosmic symbolism, and engineering achievements.• Enjoy engaging storytelling from a certified bilingual guide.• Travel comfortably with included round-trip transportation.

Included:• Shared transportation• Certified bilingual guide• Entrance to Teotihuacan• Visit to the Basilica of Guadalupe• Overnight stay in Mexico City

Not Included:• Meals• Drinks• Tips• Personal expenses
